raw.title: fix(expr): cache matches patterns and fail non-compiling ones loudly
raw.body:
fix(expr): cache matches patterns and fail non-compiling ones loudly

The matches operator (a tracked non-conformance pending the ac-ec3a1 grammar decision) moves into matches_operator.rs end to end. Compiled patterns are memoized in a bounded process-static cache (256 entries, 4096-byte pattern cap) because an ExpressionEvaluator is rebuilt per step, so the same pattern was recompiled on every criterion of every attempt. A pattern that does not compile still evaluates false but now emits a warning naming the pattern error, and the failure is memoized so retries do not re-parse it. Compilation happens outside the lock; poisoned locks recover. A bench group pins the cached-versus-uncached gap.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
